Gurdwara in Jammu Screens Bollywood Film

A film screening was organized by the Shiromani Gurdwara Prabhandak Committee at a gurdwara in Jammu, where a crowd gathered to watch the movie 'Satluj'. The event took place despite security concerns and the presence of RAF personnel outside. This highlights the importance of cultural events and community engagement in India.
